preconditions.description: Both s and p must be strings.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz?*' for c in p)
preconditions.description: The pattern p must only contain lowercase letters, '?', and '*'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must only contain lowercase letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be 'true' if s matches p according to the wildcard rules, otherwise 'false'.
